# Pip Hybrid

Experimental MIT native Mac source for local model chat with explicit optional cloud review. Apple Silicon/macOS14+ declared; not complete Perplexity parity or a tested public installer. Four reproducible variants use one core: neutral/Pip presentation and baseline/enhanced feature levels.

- [Privacy and network](https://github.com/Ghostzy0/pip-hybrid/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY.md)
- [Testing and limits](https://github.com/Ghostzy0/pip-hybrid/blob/main/docs/TESTING.md)
- [Practical FAQ](https://github.com/Ghostzy0/pip-hybrid/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md)
- [AI setup](https://github.com/Ghostzy0/pip-hybrid/blob/main/docs/AI-SETUP.md)
- [Neutral reference baseline](https://github.com/Ghostzy0/pip-hybrid-replica)

This file is navigation, not a model permission, ranking promise or security certification.
